The imported Gemma model is used for local test generation and auto-reply. CPU/GPU selection also applies to subsequent auto-reply preparation. Call instructions and utterances are processed on-device.

A compatible .litertlm model and the SHA-256 hash verified from the release page are required. Please prepare the file on your phone beforehand. The import limit is up to 6 GiB and sufficient storage is required for both original and copied files.

Test word: Apple. Generates "Apple" using English instructions to verify model execution. Leaving this screen releases the test model. Turning on auto-reply prepares the model again to wait for incoming calls.

When auto-reply is enabled, local Gemma is prepared, incoming status is checked, and after 2 seconds the call is answered and switched to Samsung Text Call. Outgoing calls are not answered. Response generation is processed on-device and call contents are not saved. Offline status of Samsung speech processing is separate. Outgoing call initiation is not supported.
Incoming check → Wait 2s → Answer & Text Call → Reply

Once model preparation completes, incoming status is verified, and after 2 seconds the call is automatically answered and converted to Samsung Text Call. Operates only when both incoming UI text and system ringing state are confirmed; outgoing calls are not answered. Speech and dialogue history are processed with on-device Gemma, and verified responses are sent to the caller.

Dialogue history is kept in memory only and cleared upon call end or release. On response formatting errors or output limit reached, a retry is requested while maintaining auto-reply. On model execution failure or timeout, auto-reply stops. Samsung speech processing remains active.

Does not apply to ongoing calls. Reconnecting the accessibility service turns off auto-reply.
